$comment: Historical MK2 → MK3 migration notes. This file is not a contribution, not a schema and is outside the loader manifest glob. It records unsupported writer/export planes and the decisions applied while the product-owned Blizzard models extension was ported.

contractGaps: capability «write»: X3 v1 is read-only (BRIEF-13A acceptance 19); needs the 13D writer/service contract
model-material-source@1 has no layer slots or resource foreign keys: MATM/MAT_/LAYR/BAT_ decoding publishes material identity and primitive materialId, while layer mappings remain receipt evidence
converterDefaults: signatures:from-specification (Blizzard M3 container header: reversed little-endian MD33 / MD34 tags at byte zero (M3_FILE_FORMAT_SPECIFICATION, header and index table))
